title: N.White
content:
**Full Name:**
Nova White

**Chinese Name:**
白

---
**IP:**
DDD

**Primary Appearances:**
DDD Presents

**Character Traits:**
Elegant, poised, quiet leader

**Hidden Traits:**
Witty, curious, enjoys teasing others

**Primary Love Interest:**
D.Dark

**Catchphrase / Mannerism:**
(Soft smile)

---
**Character Introduction:**

The leader of DDD Studio. She appears less frequently as a main character, but occasionally makes guest appearances.

Due to her romantic relationship with D.Dark, she may have more opportunities to appear as a couple alongside her.
